scam_templates.text: Dear customer, your wedding invitation is attached. Please download and install {file_apk} to view venue details.
Traffic Police Notice: Pending e-challan of Rs {amount} against vehicle {veh_num}. Download {file_apk} from http://{domain}/pay to avoid court summons.
Dear {brand_bank} user, your account will be suspended today. Install {brand_bank}_security.apk from http://{domain}/update immediately.
शादी का कार्ड देखने के लिए कृपया {file_apk} डाउनलोड करके अपने फोन में इंस्टॉल करें।
यातायात पुलिस चालान: आपका ₹{amount} का चालान बाकी है। तुरंत {file_apk} डाउनलोड करें।
Shadi ka card dekhne ke liye {file_apk} install karein aur sabhi photos dekhein.

Install urgent update f i l e : http://{shortener}/{slug} for {brand_bank}. a p k file.

{brand_bank} ग्राहक: आपका खाता आज रात 12 बजे तक बंद कर दिया जाएगा। पैन कार्ड और आधार लिंक करने के लिए http://{lookalike_domain}/login पर जाएं।
Dear user, aapka {brand_bank} account suspend hone wala hai. Turant KYC update karein: http://{lookalike_domain}/update

Urgent notice: {brand_bank} K Y C expired! V i s i t hxxp://{lookalike_domain} to unfreeze account.
Crime Branch CBI: Digital arrest warrant issued for parcel containing contraband narcotics seized in your name. Do not disconnect call, stay on Skype video conference.
Mumbai Police cyber cell: FIR lodged against Aadhaar {aadhaar_last4} for money laundering transaction of Rs {amount}. Pay security bond immediately to avoid arrest.

Delhi Police notice: Aapke naam par illegal parcel pakda gaya hai. Digital arrest warrant nikla hai call mat katna.
Dear consumer, your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM due to previous month unpaid bill of Rs {amount}. Contact electricity officer at {phone}.

प्रिय बिजली उपभोक्ता, आज रात 9:30 बजे आपका बिजली कनेक्शन काट दिया जाएगा। तुरंत बिल का भुगतान करें: http://{domain}/bill
Bijli bill jama na hone ke karan aaj raat 9:30 baje bijli kaat di jayegi. Officer ko call karo {phone}.
Congratulations! You have received cashback reward of Rs {amount} from {brand_payment}. Enter your UPI PIN to claim money in your bank account.
Refund approval: Rs {amount} approved for your order. Scan the QR code and approve request on PhonePe with your PIN to receive funds.
बधाई हो! आपको ₹{amount} का कैशबैक मिला है। पैसे अपने बैंक खाते में प्राप्त करने के लिए यूपीआई पिन दर्ज करें।
Aapka Rs {amount} cashback approve hua hai. Paise pane ke liye upi pin enter karo abhi ke abhi.
Billing settlement: Rs {amount} waiting to be credited. Authorize with your secret UPI PIN to collect balance on {brand_payment}.
Dear customer, your {brand_telecom} SIM will be deactivated today. Tell me the OTP received on your mobile to complete KYC verification.
Customer Care Officer: Share your 6 digit OTP to unfreeze your credit card immediately.
सिम कार्ड बंद होने से बचाने के लिए तुरंत अपना ओटीपी बताएं और आधार वेरीफाई करवाएं।

Bank Customer Service: Download TeamViewer quicksupport app on mobile to resolve blocked ATM card.

Customer service: Bank issue solve karne ke liye anydesk install karo aur 9 digit code batao.
Helpdesk engineer notice: For remote inspection and screen calibration, run AnyDesk application from store and provide address code.
Part-time job offer: Earn Rs 3,000 - 8,000 daily by simply rating hotels and subscribing YouTube channels. Contact manager on Telegram: https://t.me/{telegram_user}
Work from home hiring: Daily income Rs 2,500 guaranteed for Google reviews. Message on WhatsApp {phone} or Telegram.
घर बैठे ऑनलाइन काम करके रोजाना ₹3000 कमाएं। आसान काम वीडियो लाइक करना। टेलीग्राम पर संपर्क करें: https://t.me/{telegram_user}
Online part time work: Daily 2000-5000 kamaye youtube video like karke. Telegram join karo: https://t.me/{telegram_user}
Double your money in 7 days! 100% guaranteed profit in cryptocurrency & stock trading. Join our VIP insider group: https://t.me/{telegram_user}
Earn 15% daily guaranteed return on your investment. Minimum deposit Rs 1,000. Join WhatsApp group for guaranteed calls.
शेयर बाजार में 100% गारंटीड रिटर्न। 10 दिन में पैसे डबल करें। टेलीग्राम वीआईपी चैनल से जुड़ें: https://t.me/{telegram_user}
Stock market trading me guaranteed daily profit. 10000 lagao aur 50000 kamao. Telegram link: https://t.me/{telegram_user}
Dear customer, your mobile number has won cash prize of Rs 25,00,000 in KBC All India Lucky Draw. Call officer {name} at {phone} to claim prize.
बधाई हो! आपके मोबाइल नंबर ने केबीसी लकी ड्रा में 25 लाख रुपये जीते हैं। अपना इनाम क्लेम करने के लिए संपर्क करें: {phone}
Aapne jita hai 25 lakh ka lottery prize. Lottery manager se baat karne ke liye call karein {phone}.
Pre-approved instant loan of Rs {loan_amount} approved at 1% interest rate with zero CIBIL check. Click http://{domain}/loan to disburse amount in 5 minutes.
बिना किसी दस्तावेज के ₹{loan_amount} का तत्काल पर्सनल लोन मंजूर हुआ। खाते में पैसे पाने के लिए आवेदन करें: http://{domain}/apply
Instant personal loan Rs {loan_amount} bina CIBIL check ke approve ho gaya hai. Link par apply karo: http://{domain}/quick
India Post alert: Your parcel {tracking_id} could not be delivered due to wrong house address. Update address within 24 hours at http://{domain}/address to avoid return.
इंडिया पोस्ट: आपका पार्सल गलत पते के कारण नहीं पहुंच सका। कृपया अपना सही पता अपडेट करें: http://{domain}/parcel
India post delivery fail ho gayi hai address galat hone se. 24 ghante me address update karo: http://{domain}/track
Express delivery update: Package dispatch failed due to address illegible on parcel. Please reschedule drop-off slot at http://{domain}/schedule before return.
Hi, this is my new phone number. My old phone fell in water and I am stuck in an emergency hospital bill. Please send Rs {amount} urgently to UPI id {upi_id}.
नमस्ते, यह मेरा नया नंबर है। अस्पताल में एक मेडिकल इमरजेंसी हो गई है, मुझे तुरंत ₹{amount} की जरूरत है। इस यूपीआई पर भेजें: {upi_id}
Hey yeh mera new number hai. Emergency aa gayi hai please {amount} rupaye transfer kar do {upi_id} par, kal wapas de dunga.

benign_templates.text: Dear customer, Rs {amount}.00 debited from A/C XX{acct_last4} on {date} at {pos_merchant}. Avail Bal: Rs {avail_bal}. Call 1800-11-2211 if not done by you.
Your A/C XX{acct_last4} is credited by Rs {amount}.00 on {date} by NEFT/IMPS reference {ref_id}. Total available balance is Rs {avail_bal}.
आपके खाते XX{acct_last4} से ₹{amount} का भुगतान सफल रहा। शेष राशि: ₹{avail_bal}। यदि यह आपने नहीं किया है तो तुरंत बैंक को सूचित करें।
Aapke bank account XX{acct_last4} se Rs {amount} debit ho gaya hai {pos_merchant} par. Available balance hai Rs {avail_bal}.
{otp_code} is your OTP for online transaction of Rs {amount} at {pos_merchant}. Do not share your OTP with anyone, including bank officials.
Your login verification code for {brand_bank} netbanking is {otp_code}. Valid for 10 minutes. Never share this code with anyone.

Aapka {brand_bank} login OTP hai {otp_code}. Yeh code kisi ke sath share na karein, bank kabhi OTP nahi mangta.
Your package from {ecommerce_brand} containing order #{order_id} is out for delivery with our delivery associate {driver_name}. Share PIN {deliv_pin} at delivery.
Shipment {tracking_id} has been delivered successfully at your address today at {time}. Thank you for choosing BlueDart.

Aapka order delivery ke liye nikal chuka hai. Delivery boy ko receiving pin {deliv_pin} share karein parcel lene par.
Dear consumer {consumer_id}, your electricity bill for the period {bill_month} is Rs {amount}. Due date is {due_date}. Pay via official portal or app.

Consumer number {consumer_id} ka electricity bill Rs {amount} generate ho gaya hai. Last date {due_date} hai.
Hey bro, are we still meeting for lunch today at {place}? Let me know when you leave office.

कृपया मुझे ₹{amount} फोनपे पर भेज दो, मैं शाम को घर आकर वापस कर दूंगा।

Mujhe 500 rupaye GPay kar de bhai, petrol pump par khada hu network slow hai.
Hello, how are you doing? Hope everything is well with you and your family.
Good morning! Are you free for a quick telephone call today?
Hey, where are you right now? Let us catch up this evening after work.

Hello bhai, kaisa hai? Sab badhiya na? Call karna free hoke.
Guys beware: lots of fake electricity disconnection messages are going around asking to call random numbers. Do not fall for these scams.

Group me dhyan de sabhi log: koi bhi unknown number se OTP ya KYC update ka message aaye toh click mat karna, fraud ho raha hai.
Wishing you and your family a very happy and prosperous Diwali! May this year bring health and success.
